FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say the French letter E? (1 mark)
   A. uh
   B. eh
   C. ee
   D. ay

2. How do you spell the name Amina aloud in French letter names? (1 mark)
   A. ah, em, ee, en, ah
   B. ah, em, ee, ah, en
   C. ah, en, ee, em, ah
   D. ay, em, eye, en, ay

3. How do you say 'This is my father.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici ma grand-mère.
   B. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   C. C'est mon père.
   D. C'est mon frère.

4. What does 'le frère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandmother
   B. the boy
   C. the brother
   D. the father

5. How do you say 'The book is on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un lit.
   B. Voici ma maison.
   C. Le livre est sur la table.
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

6. What does 'le chat' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the chair
   B. the fridge
   C. the cat
   D. the table

7. Which day comes after dimanche? (1 mark)
   A. mardi
   B. jeudi
   C. lundi
   D. samedi

8. What does 'la semaine' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the week
   B. the church
   C. the school
   D. the day

9. What does 'l'église' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the week
   B. the school
   C. the day
   D. the church

10. How do you say 'Thank you very much!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   B. Merci beaucoup !
   C. Je chante et je danse.
   D. J'ai dix ans.

11. What number is 'un' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 19
   D. 1

12. What does 'le jus' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the mango
   B. juice
   C. beans
   D. milk

13. Fill in: C'est ______ gâteau. (1 mark)
   A. des
   B. la
   C. un
   D. une

14. Fill in: C'est ______ banane. (1 mark)
   A. une
   B. un
   C. des
   D. le

15. What does 'l'épaule' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the nose
   B. the tooth
   C. the stomach
   D. the shoulder

16. Fill in: J'ai ______ mains. (2) (1 mark)
   A. dix
   B. trois
   C. un
   D. deux

17. What does 'Il gèle.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. It is freezing.
   C. It is hot.
   D. It is cloudy.

18. What does 'beaucoup' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the snow
   B. a lot
   C. It is raining.
   D. It is cold.

19. What does 'Allez' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Go
   B. You are welcome
   C. Excuse me
   D. Turn

20. How do you say 'It is under the chair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Elle est sous la chaise.
   B. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the seven days of the week in French in order. (4 marks) (4 marks)

22. Write a short birthday dialogue of four lines. (4 marks) (4 marks)

23. Write three sentences in French with J'ai and a number about your body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Explain the difference between C'est un, C'est une and Ce sont des. (4 marks) (4 marks)

25. Explain why managing time is important and say how you use your Saturday. (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Write three sentences about foods you like and do not like in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Explain why correct pronunciation is important when you speak French. Give one example of a sound that is different from English. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Write three weather sentences in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Write the three direction words for straight, left and right in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — uh
   The letter E is said uh in French.

2. A — ah, em, ee, en, ah
   A is ah, M is em, I is ee, N is en.

3. C — C'est mon père.
   This is my father. in French is C'est mon père.

4. C — the brother
   le frère means the brother.

5. C — Le livre est sur la table.
   The book is on the table. in French is Le livre est sur la table.

6. C — the cat
   le chat means the cat.

7. C — lundi
   The week begins again with Monday.

8. A — the week
   la semaine means the week.

9. D — the church
   l'église means the church.

10. B — Merci beaucoup !
   Thank you very much! in French is Merci beaucoup !

11. D — 1
   un means 1.

12. B — juice
   le jus means juice.

13. C — un
   Gâteau is masculine.

14. A — une
   Banane is feminine.

15. D — the shoulder
   l'épaule means the shoulder.

16. D — deux
   Two hands is deux mains.

17. B — It is freezing.
   Il gèle. means It is freezing..

18. B — a lot
   beaucoup means a lot.

19. A — Go
   Allez means Go.

20. A — Elle est sous la chaise.
   It is under the chair. in French is Elle est sous la chaise.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all correct in order; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Bon anniversaire ! Merci ! Tu as quel âge ? J'ai dix ans.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux mains. J'ai dix doigts. J'ai deux pieds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: C'est un is for one masculine thing, C'est une is for one feminine thing, and Ce sont des is for many things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pattern and 1 mark for an example.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Managing time helps us finish work and rest. On Saturday, I help at home and play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for importance and 2 marks for a correct example.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'aime la mangue. J'aime le lait. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Correct pronunciation helps people understand you and shows respect for the language. For example, the letter j says zh, as in bonjour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for understanding, 1 mark for respect or communication, 1 mark for a correct example.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Il fait beau. Il pleut. Il y a du vent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: tout droit, à gauche, à droite
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
